title: SSR fails due to call of window.encodeURI in numeric menu component
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

The following call to window from https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/ccf159efcb94e9c8c04c558fcb69e2e3d8d79729/src/connectors/numeric-menu/connectNumericMenu.ts

```
const prepareItems = (state: SearchParameters) =>
  items.map(({ start, end, label }) => ({
    label,
    value: (window as any).encodeURI(JSON.stringify({ start, end })),
    isRefined: isRefined(state, attribute, { start, end, label }),
  }));
```

causes SSR to fail when using the numeric menu

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**

This live example is for vue-instantsearch which I am using, but I assume it happens for all flavors.

https://codesandbox.io/s/goofy-northcutt-kttko?file=/pages/search.vue

## 💭 Expected behavior

No call to window

## Environment

I assume all
